scientific_scope_status: For smooth real divergence-free unforced 2D Navier–Stokes flow on (R/2pi Z)^2 with normalized area, viscosity nu>0 and initial L2 velocity norm <=E, the supplied information is the exact square Fourier snapshot P_K u(0), with |j|_infinity<=K including the zero mode, and K,E,nu,T. The output is the entire P_K velocity path on [0,T], measured in supremum-time L2 error; unlimited predictor computation is allowed. For integer K>=16, the source gives 1e-8 E^2 min{K^2 T,1/(nu+E)} <= minimax error <=10 E^2 min{K^2 T,1/(nu+E)}. This is a source-reported full proof with informed internal cross-reconstruction, not an independently verified theorem. An observed nonzero mean is handled by a Galilean frame.
